name: empty-state
description: Placeholder for empty content sections with icon, title, description, and action slots

changes.note: Nested components keep their own parts. The icon, title, description and actions rules were descendant selectors, and those are part names half the registry shares: a callout or card placed inside an empty state had its title resized and recoloured. They are child selectors now, which is the canonical markup. No rule changes specificity.

data-size="sm" is now declared (it was in empty-state.css and in no manifest). Its default is empty because absence is a real value here rather than a synonym for a medium size: an unsized empty-state keeps the roomy base padding, and only sm has a rule. No CSS or behaviour change. 0.8-10's undeclared-attribute rule now makes this class of drift impossible: an attribute a component's CSS selects on that its manifest never declares fails the registry gate.

tests: Compact size reduces spacing and font
